papers.title: Retrieval evaluation with answer relevance judgments
papers.abstract: Answer relevance judgments compare retrieved passages with explicit question needs. Graded labels support ranking metrics across a held-out query set.

papers.title: Retrieval evaluation under incomplete relevance labels
papers.abstract: Incomplete relevance labels alter ranking metrics when unjudged passages are treated as irrelevant. Pooling strategies estimate label coverage across query sets.

papers.title: Retrieval evaluation with latency budgets
papers.abstract: Latency budgets constrain candidate generation in interactive search. Throughput and tail latency measurements expose tradeoffs at different query loads.

papers.title: Retrieval evaluation for cached search
papers.abstract: Cached search reduces tail latency for repeated questions. Throughput measurements under query loads distinguish cache hits from misses.

papers.title: Retrieval evaluation across multilingual queries
papers.abstract: Multilingual queries require language-specific relevance labels. Translation artifacts can distort ranking metrics across languages.

papers.title: Retrieval evaluation for translated questions
papers.abstract: Translated questions introduce language-specific ambiguity. Multilingual relevance labels reveal ranking differences across languages.
